items.text: Upload a polyglot GIF/PHP file past extension-only validation → locate a separate 'restore from backup' feature that extracts the archive into the webroot without re-validating extracted file types → achieve RCE via the planted file

Upload an SVG with embedded XML entities past a content-type check that only inspects the declared MIME → the avatar-processing pipeline resizes it via a vulnerable image library → trigger XXE/SSRF from the server-side processing step

Upload a crafted .docx to a 'convert to PDF' feature → the conversion service has a known RCE in its document-parsing library → achieve code execution on the conversion worker, then pivot to its internal network access

Upload a ZIP with a zip-slip path-traversal entry to a 'bulk import' feature → extraction writes a file outside the intended directory into a location the app later executes as a cron/scheduled script
